Subject: Redwood architecture deep-dive — exec attendance options and agenda

Hi Jessica / Michael,

Thanks again for the interest in a technical deep-dive. Per our conversation last week, the goal for this session is to:
- walkthrough the end-to-end inference architecture that would support Orion's near-term throughput needs
- call out integration points for data governance and KMS
- surface performance/latency SLAs and failure modes

We typically structure this as a 90–120 minute session with 30 minutes reserved for exec-level Q&A (board/CTO audience). To make sure your leadership can attend, can you confirm which of these windows work for Michael (CTO)?

Option A: Fri, Nov 20 — 09:00–11:00 PT
Option B: Mon, Nov 23 — 13:00–15:00 PT
Option C: Tue, Nov 24 — 10:00–12:00 PT

I've attached a draft agenda and a proposed roles matrix (who will speak to infra, privacy, and contracts). If none of these are possible, share two alternatives and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Attaching: agenda-arch-deep-dive-20261120.pdf; roles-proposed-20261120.xlsx

Next steps: once Michael confirms a slot, Evelyn and Lauren will finalize Redwood's attendee list and slide owners.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — Michael can make two of the windows but prefers the earlier one. He is available:
- Fri, Nov 20 — 09:00–11:00 PT (best)
- Tue, Nov 24 — 10:00–12:00 PT (backup)

A few asks from our side so the session is productive for the board:
1) Please surface any single-tenant/deployment isolation options (we need KMS + audit log detail).
2) Can you include a short run-book for incident escalation (RTO/RPO expectations)?
3) If you have a short pre-read (2–3 pages) that calls out capacity planning assumptions, please share — our execs will skim beforehand.

If Nov 20 works, we will block Michael and our CIO on that calendar invite; otherwise we'll confirm the backup.

Best,
Jessica Park
Director, Platform Engineering | Orion Analytics

Jessica — Nov 20 (09:00 PT) works for Redwood.

Lauren will represent Redwood at the exec table and lead the 30-minute leadership Q&A. Marcus will run the infrastructure and SLO section. Aditya, can you please:
- send a calendar invite for Nov 20 09:00–11:00 PT to Michael + CIO + our attendees
- attach a 1–2 page pre-read summarizing capacity assumptions and the deployment matrix (single-tenant vs shared)
- include the run-book appendix for escalation details as Jessica requested

We will aim to keep the pre-read concise; Marcus, can you draft the incident run-book snippet (bullet format) and share by COB Monday?

Thanks — I will hold the slot and coordinate internally if anything shifts.
